% Method overview (generated by experiments/main_figures_tikz.py)
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\sffamily\fontsize{7}{8.4}\selectfont, >={Stealth[length=4pt]},
  box/.style={draw=#1, line width=0.6pt, fill=white, align=center, inner sep=3pt, minimum height=0.9cm, text width=2.3cm},
  box/.default=sforange,
  grp/.style={draw=black!70, densely dotted, line width=0.7pt, fill=#1, inner sep=0pt},
  hdr/.style={font=\sffamily\fontsize{7}{8.4}\selectfont\bfseries, anchor=north, inner sep=2pt},
  arr/.style={->, line width=0.7pt}]
% ---- boxes
\node[box=black!60] (img) at (0,0.62) {posed survey images\\ $I_1,\dots,I_N$};
\node[box=black!60] (dep) at (0,-0.62) {one depth map\\ per image, $\hat d_i$};
\node[box] (pose) at (3.05,0.62) {trajectory spline,\\ render-and-compare};
\node[box] (map) at (3.05,-0.62) {2DGS surfels with\\ $\Lambda_k=\Lambda_0+\sum_i\Lambda_k^{(i)}$};
\node[box=sfred, text width=2.55cm] (cav) at (6.25,0.62) {cavity: subtract $\mathcal{B}_j$\\ $\Lambda_k-\sum_{i\in\mathcal{B}_j}\Lambda_k^{(i)}$};
\node[box=sfred, text width=2.55cm] (ren) at (6.25,-0.62) {render into view $j$:\\ $\hat D_{-j}$, $V_{-j}$};
\node[box=sfred, text width=2.55cm] (tst) at (6.25,-1.86) {whiten by $\Sigma_r$;\\ region scan $\max_{\mathcal{R}}|z_{\mathcal{R}}|$};
\node[draw=black!70, line width=0.6pt, fill=white, diamond, aspect=1.7, inner sep=1pt, align=center] (dec) at (9.6,-0.95) {flagged\\ after Holm?};
\node[box=sfred, fill=sfred!8, text width=2.0cm] (out) at (9.6,0.55) {kept views and\\ fused surface};
% ---- stage groups (drawn behind)
\coordinate (top) at (0,1.62);
\coordinate (bot) at (0,-2.42);
\begin{scope}[on background layer]
\node[grp=black!3, fit=(img)(dep)(img|-top)(img|-bot), inner xsep=6pt] (g1) {};
\node[grp=sforange!6, fit=(pose)(map)(pose|-top)(pose|-bot), inner xsep=6pt] (g2) {};
\node[grp=sfred!5, fit=(cav)(ren)(tst)(cav|-top)(cav|-bot), inner xsep=6pt] (g3) {};
\node[grp=black!3, fit=(dec)(out)(dec|-top)(dec|-bot), inner xsep=6pt] (g4) {};
\end{scope}
\foreach \g/\t in {g1/Data, g2/Shared surface, g3/Test of view $j$ \textcolor{sfred}{(this paper)}, g4/Decision} {
  \node[hdr] at (\g.north) {\t};
  \draw[black!50, densely dashed, line width=0.4pt] ([yshift=-0.42cm]\g.north west) -- ([yshift=-0.42cm]\g.north east);
}
% ---- flow
\draw[arr] (img) -- (pose);
\draw[arr] (dep) -- (map);
\draw[arr] (pose) -- (map);
\draw[arr] (map.east) -- ++(0.32,0) |- (cav.west);
\draw[arr] (cav) -- (ren);
\draw[arr] (ren) -- (tst);
\draw[arr] (tst.east) -| node[pos=0.25, below, inner sep=2pt] {all $j$} (dec.south);
\draw[arr] (dec) -- node[right, inner sep=2pt] {no} (out);
\draw[arr, sfred, dashed] (dec.east) -- ++(0.35,0) |- ($(g3.south)+(0,-0.3)$) -| node[pos=0.25, below, inner sep=2pt, text=sfred]
  {yes: drop the top flagged view, retrain} (map.south);
\end{tikzpicture}
